title: Quick Roasted Australian Lentil Bowl
description: A salty and crisp meal prep Australian dish featuring cumin and caramelized flavors, perfect for plant-based diets. This recipe is easy to make and packed with nutrients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the lentils with 1 tablespoon of olive oil, cumin, salt, and black pepper until they are evenly coated.
Spread the lentils on a baking sheet and roast for 20 minutes.
In a large skillet, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook until it is caramelized, stirring occasionally.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chopped carrots and zucchini to the skillet and cook until they are tender, stirring occasionally.
To assemble the bowls, divide the roasted lentils among four bowls and top with the skillet mixture.
